September 23, 2026 remains the verified OpenRouter listing date rather than a confirmed earliest public release. summary: The fresh availability audit classifies Prime as closed: Alibaba documents a hosted Fast mode SKU, and actual official Qwen repository searches found no downloadable Prime release. The separately open 2.4T-A95B checkpoint does not establish exact Prime weight availability. The report also proposes a service-tier exclusion related to alibaba/qwen3.8-max, based on Alibaba’s exact pricing-to-mode link and its explicit original-capabilities/limits statement, corroborated by Vercel’s high-speed-edition description. This exclusion is supported by product identity, not by failure to find a date. The SKU launch date remains null after original release-history/newsletter checks; secondary conference dates and provider listing timestamps are not substituted. All existing parameter assessments and other unrelated facts are preserved, including nominal 2400B total/95B active and MoE inferences, their exact-tensor limitations, and unresolved dated snapshot/license mapping.
